title: Pure in Youth
subtitle: A Persian saying, and a hadith about shade

content.text: There is a well-known Persian couplet:
In Persian, line 1: در جوانی پاک بودن شیوهٔ پیغمبری است
In Persian, line 2: ورنه هر گبری به پیری می‌شود پرهیزگار
Dar jawaani paak boodan sheewa-e paighambari ast; warna har gabri ba-peeri mee-shawad parheezgaar.
"To be pure in youth is the way of the prophets; otherwise, in old age even a fire-worshipper turns pious."

What a wonderful way to put a simple truth. Turning to Allah when your strength has gone and your desires have faded is easy. Holding on to purity when you are young, strong and tempted is the real test.
Shade on the Day of Judgment

The Prophet ﷺ named seven kinds of people whom Allah will shade on the Day when there is no shade but His. One of them is شَابٌّ نَشَأَ فِي عِبَادَةِ اللَّهِ "a young man who grew up in the worship of Allah" (Bukhari 660, Muslim 1031).
If you are young, this is your moment. If you have children, help them grow up close to Allah.
